## 变更说明 | Description

<!-- 这个 PR 改了什么、为什么改 | What this PR changes and why -->

## 变更类型 | Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug 修复 | Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ 新功能 | New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 破坏性变更 | Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing usage to change)
- [ ] 📝 文档 | Documentation
- [ ] 🔧 重构/工具链 | Refactor / tooling

## 自查清单 | Checklist

- [ ] 已运行 `pnpm test` 且全部通过 | `pnpm test` passes locally
- [ ] 已运行 `pnpm run lint` 无错误 | `pnpm run lint` reports no errors
- [ ] 如改动生成器模板/输出形态，已更新 `tests/e2e` 快照（`npx vitest run tests/e2e -u`）| E2E snapshots updated if generator output changed intentionally
- [ ] 已同步更新相关文档（`docs/`、`README.md`、`README.en.md`）| Related docs updated in sync
- [ ] 提交信息符合 Conventional Commits（`feat:` / `fix:` / `docs:` ...）| Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
